_comment: Krea 2 depth Control LoRA (Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet) for the pure-Swift krea2-image-director `controlnet` subcommand. NOT a standalone ControlNet — a rank-64 Control LoRA (224 pairs on blocks.0..27 × {attn.wq,wk,wv,wo,gate, mlp.gate,up,down}) + an expanded first.weight (6144,128) whose control half [:,64:128] projects the control latent at the DiT input. α=rank=64 → scale 1.0. bf16, NOT quantized. Weights externalized to the content-addressed store; this in-tree entry is a symlink.
name: krea2-depth-control-lora
description: Krea 2 depth Control LoRA (rank 64, 224 pairs + expanded input projection). Loaded by Krea2ControlLoRA.swift; injected into the DiT weight dict and applied in Krea2DiT.lin().
author_notes: Downloaded 2026-07-04 from HF as depth-control-lora.safetensors (862MB), relocated to the content-addressed store, symlinked here as model.safetensors (the loader's expected name). Real-silicon validated: loader reports 224/224 pairs; control signal monotonic + control-image identity matters. See docs/controlnet-styletransfer-validation.md.
